hostAcceptance.evidenceRule: Every EXECUTED record copies the IQ-4F entry anchor into result.sourceCommit and binds the synthetic input, recomputed stdout, exit code 0, date, and notes. Codex, whose install mode is repo, must bind result.candidateSourceCommit to the verified checkout and leave candidateSha256 null. Qoder, WorkBuddy, and Doubao must bind result.candidateSha256 to their pinned installed ZIP digest and leave candidateSourceCommit null. Rebuilding candidates invalidates earlier host evidence (release checklist A4). Four-host technical acceptance cannot lift BLOCKED_SOURCE_ADMISSION.
